note: Two kinds of item are published here: (1) repository irregularities found during this session's line-by-line review, each with the evidence and the action taken; (2) values that earlier sessions publish but that this session could not re-verify against an official source. Nothing on this page blocks the publication of the site, and nothing here is silently corrected in another session's files.

irregularities.title: The published root build cited a Census URL that silently drops the county column
irregularities.detail: data/sources.json source S2 (used by the live root site for every Los Angeles County row) pointed at .../table/losangelescitycalifornia,lacountycalifornia/PST045224. Read on 2026-11-08, that slug renders a table titled 'United States' with no county data at all. The correct slug is losangelescountycalifornia.
irregularities.evidence: https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/losangelescitycalifornia,lacountycalifornia/PST045224 returns a table whose only column is the City of Los Angeles; https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/fact/table/losangelescountycalifornia/PST045224 returns Los Angeles County with population 9,694,934.
irregularities.impact: The county values themselves are correct (re-verified here as D03, D04, D06, D08, D10), but a reader following the link could not see them. A citation that does not show its own value is a verification failure even when the number is right.
irregularities.action: FIXED in this integration session: S2 in data/sources.json now points at the two-column URL with the correct county slug, and the root site was rebuilt and re-checked. Recorded here rather than changed silently.

irregularities.action: Not edited in other sessions' files (out of this session's scope). The corrected URL is published as S12 and used for every hazard row on this site.

irregularities.title: A BEA county personal-income release URL cited by earlier sessions returns HTTP 404
irregularities.detail: https://www.bea.gov/news/2025/personal-income-county-metro-and-other-areas-2024 served a 'Page You Requested Was Not Found' page on 2026-11-08.

irregularities.action: Left out rather than copied. Listed as carried-unverified below. The county income measure used on this site is the Census median household income (D06), which was read directly.

irregularities.title: A November 2026 statewide measure affecting local real-estate transfer taxes was reported but not verified
irregularities.detail: Secondary sources describe a ballot measure that would raise the approval threshold for local special taxes and bar charter cities from real-estate transfer taxes above the 0.11% state-authorized rate.
irregularities.evidence: No official Secretary of State or Legislative Analyst page was read in this session.
irregularities.impact: If enacted it would change the Measure ULA economics materially. It is mentioned on the tax page only as an unverified watch item and is not used in any calculation.
irregularities.action: Risk RK23 carries it with a blank source.

irregularities.title: Two incompatible structure-destruction counts for January 2025 appear in the repository
irregularities.detail: Session H publishes '16,251 LA County / 16,264 CAL FIRE structures destroyed' in the same sentence. Two different authoritative counts can legitimately differ, but presenting both without attribution invites misreading.
irregularities.impact: No effect on the sell-vs-renew arithmetic; both are far larger than any single-parcel exposure.
irregularities.action: Recorded. Not used as a model input and not republished here.

irregularities.title: City of Los Angeles minimum wage of $18.42/hour is carried, not verified
irregularities.detail: Session H cites a City of Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards memo setting $18.42/hour from 2026-07-01.
irregularities.evidence: Not re-read in this session. Only the state ($16.90) and fast-food ($20.00) floors were verified (W01, W02).
irregularities.impact: The local floor matters to the tenant's cost base; the state and fast-food figures already bound the analysis directionally.
irregularities.action: Left out of the verified tables; noted here.

irregularities.title: California DOF population projections are cited from a workbook this session could not read
irregularities.detail: Sessions C and H publish Los Angeles County projections for 2030, 2035 and 2040 from CA DOF Report P-2A (Vintage 2026).
irregularities.evidence: The DOF projections page was read and does publish P-2A (Vintage 2026, released 2026-03-13), but the data itself is in an .xlsx workbook that this session's tooling cannot parse, so the individual year values could not be confirmed cell by cell.
irregularities.impact: Long-run population decline is well supported by the verified Census change figures (D02 -0.8%, D04 -3.2%), which is what the model needs.
irregularities.action: The projection link is published here as the official page; the individual year values are not republished as verified.

irregularities.title: Los Angeles County documentary transfer tax of 0.11% is used by earlier sessions but not verified here
irregularities.detail: Several earlier pages apply a 0.11% county documentary transfer tax alongside the City rate.
irregularities.evidence: The County Registrar-Recorder page was not read in this session.
irregularities.impact: At a $1.7m price the difference is about $1,900 — immaterial to the ranking, material to a closing statement.
irregularities.action: The city transfer tax and Measure ULA (X01-X05, S09) are verified and used; the county component is omitted from this model rather than assumed.
